content.body:
The Air Warning System lays a grid over the theater map and labeled coordinates for each grid. If enemy aircraft are present within a grid square, that square is colored (yellow for light presence, red for heavy).
This is not as precise as radar. It reflects the combination of intelligence and spotters reporting enemy aircraft. There is also some delay in the AWS because of this. However, it still helps pilots and anti-aircraft gunners find the enemy.
content.title: Air Warning System
